en.summary: An ambitious Harvard grad is seduced by a powerful D.C. couple in Netflix's upcoming erotic thriller. Starring Kerry Washington, James Marsden, and Chloe East, the film dives into a dangerous world of sex, power, and murder.
en.body:
Get ready for a dark dive into the corridors of power. **Kerry Washington**, **James Marsden**, and **Chloe East** are set to star in Netflix's new erotic thriller, **An Innocent Girl**, helmed by director **Jaume Collet-Serra**.

The film, currently deep in post-production with a projected 2027 release window, centers on Sophie Walker, a fresh-out-of-Harvard idealist arriving in Washington D.C. with dreams of changing the world. However, her idealistic vision is quickly shattered when she becomes entangled with a high-powered D.C. couple – the Vice President and her husband. What begins as a seductive affair spirals into a perilous web of sex, power, and murder, pushing Sophie far beyond her initial intentions.

> "In this dramatic psychological thriller, fresh-out-of-Harvard idealist Sophie Walker arrives in Washington determined to change the world, only to be seduced by a high-powered D.C. couple — the Vice President and her husband — and drawn into a clandestine affair that plunges her into a dangerous web of sex, power, and murder." — Production Weekly synopsis

## The Power Players

This isn't just another political drama; the ensemble cast hints at a complex narrative. **Kerry Washington** is expected to play the "Second Lady," the Vice President's wife, a role that promises layers of intrigue given her previous work on Netflix, including **American Son** and **The Prom**. **James Marsden** steps into the role of the Vice President, a casting choice that immediately brings a certain charismatic intensity. Meanwhile, **Chloe East**, most recently seen in **The Fabelmans** and a brief stint on Netflix's **No Good Deed**, is likely portraying the ambitious Sophie Walker, the audience's entry point into this morally ambiguous world.

The supporting cast is equally compelling, featuring **Colman Domingo**, **Kim Dickens**, **Paul Sparks**, and **Rob Corddry**. With **Greg Berlanti** and **Sarah Schecter** producing for Berlanti/Schecter Films, known for their knack for compelling character-driven stories, and **Jaume Collet-Serra** directing, who has a proven track record with thrillers like **Orphan** and **The Shallows**, **An Innocent Girl** is shaping up to be a significant release.

## What Fans Are Anticipating

The combination of a high-stakes plot involving political power, illicit affairs, and murder, coupled with a cast featuring beloved actors like **Kerry Washington** and **James Marsden**, has generated considerable buzz. Fans are eager to see how **Collet-Serra** will navigate the erotic and psychological thriller elements, particularly how the narrative will explore the corrupting influence of power. The potential for a gripping, character-focused story that delves into moral ambiguity is what has the fan community talking, especially given the film's late-stage post-production status.

## What's Next

With **An Innocent Girl** currently in post-production, the primary focus is on the official release date announcement from Netflix. Fans can expect more details regarding the film's marketing campaign and potential festival premieres as we move closer to the anticipated 2027 release window.

Chloe East is most likely playing Sophie Walker. To date, East’s only Netflix role is Emily Morgan in the black comedy series No Good Deed .
